description: YHDrainPro-201 Plastic Drainage Board(PBD) is a high-performance drainage and protection layer manufactured from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) through a continuous thermoforming process. The board features uniformly distributed studs that create continuous drainage channels, providing efficient collection and discharge of groundwater while protecting the waterproofing membrane from mechanical damage.
advantages: Protects waterproofing membranes against backfill damage
Resistant to bacteria, fungi, and root penetration
Excellent durability and long service life
Resistant to moisture, soil chemicals, and underground environments
notFor: Ensure the waterproofing membrane has been completed and accepted prior to installation.
The substrate should be clean and free from protrusions or sharp objects that may damage the drainage board.
Avoid prolonged exposure to UV radiation before installation.

standards.value: Plastic board for drainage and protection
Profiled sheets: polymer waterproof materials, part 1: waterproof sheet

technicalData.label: Compression performance: maximum strength at 20% compression (kPa)
Longitudinal water flow rate under 150kPa side pressure (cm³/s)

mixing: Install the drainage board with the studs facing the waterproofing membrane. Adjacent sheets shall be overlapped in accordance with project specifications to maintain continuous drainage paths. For composite drainage systems, install the geotextile layer facing the soil.
storage: Store rolls vertically or horizontally on a flat surface in a dry, well-ventilated area. Protect from direct sunlight, open flames, and mechanical damage during transportation and storage. Do not stack products excessively to avoid deformation.
